superPanel.title: Super Panel
superPanel.tableOfContentsDesc: Quickly generate document TOC and outline
superPanel.pageLockDesc: Lock page to prevent accidental editing
superPanel.generalSettingsDesc: Font, heading, code block and other general configurations
superPanel.qrCodeDesc: Generate QR codes from text or links
superPanel.profileNamePlaceholder: Profile name, e.g. My Config A
superPanel.profileManagerDesc: A profile stores the full AI config (provider/model/key/endpoint/thinking/search). Saving with the same name overwrites it; Apply fills all fields and takes effect immediately.
superPanel.customModelDesc: Must match the model name provided by the API service, e.g. gpt-4o, qwen-plus
superPanel.customEndpointDesc: Supports either an OpenAI-compatible base URL (e.g. https://api.example.com/v1, /chat/completions appended automatically) or a full endpoint URL
superPanel.bochaDescEnd: for an API key, 1000 free requests per month
superPanel.searchJinaHint: Jina Search is free, no API key required, works out of the box. Ideal for light use; Bocha recommended for heavy use.
superPanel.searchNoResults: Search returned no results, please check your config
superPanel.thinkingDesc: Enable deep thinking before answering, ideal for complex reasoning tasks
superPanel.resourceManagerDesc: Manage Siyuan asset files: view, rename, insert, and clean up resources
superPanel.heatmapMarkerDesc: Automatically marks English words from the wordbook in documents, showing a heatmap gradient based on practice count
superPanel.skillsViewerDesc: View and manage AI coding tools Skills configuration files
superPanel.themeColorDesc: Override SiYuan CSS variables to switch global theme color
